description: 2 tactical challenges for White against Noah's Ark Trap. Recapture with the queen and never let the b3 bishop get trapped.

drills.briefExplanation: 7.Qxd4! — recapture with the queen, keeping the bishop safe and the center stable.
drills.description: White to play. Black pushed 5...b5 — retreat 6.Bb3, then meet 6...Nxd4 with 7.Qxd4!.
drills.explanation: The simple antidote to Noah's Ark: 7.Qxd4! recaptures with the queen instead of the knight. Now 7...exd4 is impossible (the pawn is pinned... rather, there's no pawn to take), and Black has no trap — White keeps the bishop pair and the better center. The ark only works if White recaptures 7.Nxd4?? first.
drills.name: Queen Takes First

drills.briefExplanation: 8.Bd5! Rb8 9.c3 Nf6 — block the c-pawn's advance and untangle before Black's trap is set.
drills.description: White to play. The knights are gone and Black took on d4 — don't touch the queen.
drills.explanation: If White has already played 7.Nxd4, the damage limitation is 8.Bd5! — the bishop blocks the ...c5 advance and eyes b7. After 8...Rb8 9.c3 Nf6 White untangles: the d4 pawn will fall, the bishops stay active, and Black's 'trap' never gets its second act. Prevention beats cure, but cure still beats 8.Qxd4??.
drills.name: Blocking the Flood
